name: Athletics
text: Climbing, swimming, jumping, forcing a door, hauling a body clear of a collapse. The applied use of your own strength against the world.

name: Smithing
text: Working metal: repairing damaged gear, reforging salvage into something serviceable, judging whether a blade is sound or about to fail.

name: Stealth
text: Moving unheard and unseen, choosing sightlines, staying still when stillness is what saves you.

name: Lockwork
text: Locks, latches, traps, and the small mechanisms of the old world. Opening what was meant to stay shut, and disarming what was meant to punish you for it.

name: Sleight of Hand
text: Lifting, palming, planting, and any work where the hand must be quicker than the eye watching it.

name: Acrobatics
text: Balance, tumbling, catching yourself, and crossing ground that will not hold still — rooftops, rubble, rope, and rot.

name: Scavenging
text: Reading a ruin for what is still worth taking, knowing which rooms were stripped decades ago and which were never opened, and judging what will function once cleaned.

name: Ruin-Lore
text: Knowing what a place was before it fell: old signage and script, the shape of pre-Silence buildings, which structures carried water, power, or weapons.

name: Field Medicine
text: Stopping bleeding, setting bone, cleaning a wound that will otherwise turn, and knowing when someone cannot be saved.

name: Toxicology
text: Poisons, venoms, reagents, and antidotes — identifying them by sight or smell, brewing them, and treating what they do.

name: Survival
text: Foraging, water, shelter, weather, and tracking. Keeping a group alive across open country and following what passed through it.

name: Arcana
text: Recognizing magic for what it is: which School an effect belongs to, roughly how strong it is, and whether a warded object is safe to touch.

name: Persuasion
text: Argument, appeal, and negotiation — moving someone who is not obliged to move, and knowing what they actually want.

name: Deception
text: Lying well, holding a false identity, and reading whether the person across from you is doing the same.

name: Command
text: Rallying the frightened, giving orders that are obeyed under pressure, and putting enough weight behind a threat that it lands.

name: Beast-Handling
text: Calming, driving, and working alongside animals, from a nervous pack mule to something the Silence changed.
